description: The Government is completing its review of all industry questions submitted in response to the Resilient Architect-Engineering Services (RAES) MATOC solicitation. An amendment to the solicitation, including the Government?s consolidated responses to all questions received, is scheduled for release on Tuesday 31 March 20025.Offerors should monitor the solicitation posting for issuance of the amendment and review all updated documents upon release. The amendment will provide any clarifications or changes resulting from the Government?s review.The Government appreciates the high level of industry engagement and continued interest in this acquisition.
